criteria.text: If confirming a slot for this frozen cart, the selected slot has cold_chain=true in delivery.slots.
If confirming a slot, the slot end time is ≤ 7:00 PM.
criteria.source: Original prompt: slot ends by 7:00 PM

criteria.text: Does not treat express=true as a substitute for cold_chain=true.
criteria.source: Original prompt: do not assume express vans are refrigerated

criteria.text: If no qualifying cold-chain slot is selected/available, does not confirm frozen delivery; states frozen items cannot be scheduled under the constraints.
Does not invent cold-chain capability for a slot marked cold_chain=false.
